decisionsTitle: «Tombolă», a folded section of the editor's race numbers, open again after the save that moved it — and a runner's «V7» on the raffle's form told whose number it is (amending how §949 and §984 drew the raffle's settings)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-20, from a phone, looking at the editor's raffle settings:** «vreau să le dau automat numere și voluntarilor, pentru că văd că deși voluntarii sunt bifați aici… cumva sunt excluși de pe lista de la tombolă» (I want to give the volunteers numbers automatically too, because although the volunteers are ticked here, somehow they are left out of the raffle's list) — «plus că aici ar trebui să fie o secțiune colapsată cu „Tombola”» (and here there should be a collapsed section, «Tombola»). The first half is the decision «Every volunteer numbered V001, V002, … by themselves», landed in the same release; this one is the second half, and what the two branches left between them.

**What was there.** §949 put «Avem tombolă» in the editor's «Numere de concurs (BIB)», because a raffle is drawn on the race numbers, and §984 added under it «Cine poate participa la tombolă», «Cum participă» and «Înscrierile la tombolă sunt deschise» — a dozen open lines in the card, between the first number's box and the bib designer. The volunteers ticked there read «Nu · fără număr» on the «Tombolă» tab: §984's one answer takes a volunteer only confirmed and with a number, and a volunteer had a number only once the club had set «Numerele voluntarilor încep de la» (§948), which this race never had.

**Decision.**

- **«Tombolă», one fold.** Everything about the raffle in the editor — «Avem tombolă» and, under it while it is ticked, «Cine poate participa la tombolă» with its three ticks, «Cum participă», «Înscrierile la tombolă sunt deschise» and their help — is one level-4 fold, `#box-raffle`, of «Numere de concurs (BIB)», where §949 put it, its glyph the wrapped prize. Closed on arrival, the editor's rule for an option a race may skip; its bar says «nu avem» / “none” without a raffle, else who takes part and how — «Alergători, elite, voluntari · din oficiu», «Alergători · cu înscriere separată», «Nicio grupă bifată · din oficiu» — from the saved event (`box-summaries.ts#raffleSummary`). It opens by itself right after the save that moved one of its boxes: the save says so (`saveEventAndTranslations` → `raffleChanged`, `domain/raffle.ts#raffleSettingsMoved`), the action adds `raffle=1` to the redirect beside `saved=event`, and the editor opens the card, the race numbers and «Tombolă» (`openWhen.saved`), as the race numbers' card opens after a press in the elite card (§895); `raffle=1` beside any other banner opens nothing. A box a refusal names opens the folds around it, as every fold's does (`ActionForm`'s `revealField`; with scripts off, `BOXED_DISCLOSURE_SX`). The boxes, their names, their markers and the one editor save are §984's, unchanged. «Schimbă în editor» on the tab now lands on the fold itself (`#box-raffle`, opened with every card around it by `OpenFoldFromHash`), and the tab's sentence for an event without a raffle names it («„Numere de concurs” → „Tombolă”»).
- **The volunteers number themselves, so the fold says nothing about numbers.** Every volunteer draws the event's next V number at «Confirmă», the ones confirmed before were numbered by the V series' migration, and one confirmed in the deployment's few minutes by the registration maintenance job. The fold's branch had drawn, under «Voluntarii» and on «Ziua cursei» → «Tombolă», a line «N voluntari confirmați nu au număr…» with a link to «Numerele voluntarilor încep de la»; that form went with the V series, and the line, its link, its anchor and its count went with it before they ever shipped. Why a volunteer is out of the raffle is what the person's row on «Tombolă» says, and for a volunteer it now comes down to three things: not confirmed yet, taken out by the organizers, or — «Cu înscriere separată» — not signed up (`raffleParticipation`; `noNumber` stays for a registration without a race number, and for a volunteer only in the deployment's few minutes, the row alone saying so).
- **A runner's «V7» on the raffle's form is told whose number it is.** The form's number box takes an optional V for the volunteers' numbers whether «Sunt voluntar» is ticked or not — one pattern, since following the tick would take a client island for one sentence. So a runner who types «V7» with the box unticked passes the browser and is refused by the server as the box to fix; the words under it now say whose number that is: «Un număr care începe cu V e al unui voluntar: bifează „Sunt voluntar” mai jos. Numărul de concurs al unui alergător are doar cifre.» / “A number starting with V is a volunteer's: tick “I'm a volunteer” below. A runner's race number is digits only.” (`Event.raffle.errors.volunteerNumber`), chosen by the page from what the refused post kept, and only where «Sunt voluntar» is drawn; any other refusal of the number keeps «Scrie numărul de concurs, doar cifre.».
- **Nothing else.** The raffle's rules (`raffleParticipation`), its lists, its files, its doors and the draw are §984's and the V series', unchanged.

**Refused.**

- *A line for the volunteers the deployment leaves without a V number for a few minutes.* The maintenance job numbers them by itself; a line about them would ask an organizer to do nothing, and each row says «fără număr» meanwhile.
- *Opening «Tombolă» after every save of the editor.* A fold that opens for a save that changed nothing in it opens for no reason (§336); the save says when it moved the raffle.
- *Opening the fold on every visit.* An option a race may skip stays closed until it is just saved, or until a refusal or a link names it.

**Who.** The fold is the Administrator's, as the editor's save is (§542); «Schimbă în editor» on the tab is drawn for whoever may press it (`canEditEventFields`). The raffle's form is public, as §984 made it; only its words for one refusal change.

**A reader of the switch, reviewed.** The fold's closed bar reads «Avem tombolă» and the raffle's settings from the saved event, as the box beneath it does, so `box-summaries.ts#raffleSummary` joins §949's list of the files that may name them (`tests/unit/registrations/raffle-never-leaves.test.ts`): the editor's own, the Administrator's — never a public page, an email or the desk.

**Proof.** `tests/unit/content/raffle-fold-render.test.ts` (the fold, its bar in both languages, its names, open after its save and around a refused box, which save opens it, nothing about the volunteers' numbers in it or in either catalogue), `tests/integration/volunteers/raffle-fold.test.ts` (the editor page's flag, the save's `raffle=1`, «Schimbă în editor» on `#box-raffle`, the tab counting V001 and V002 with nothing about setting numbers, a straggler's row alone, no page giving a number), `tests/integration/volunteers/raffle-public-screens.test.ts` (the words for «V7» unticked, and the plain ones elsewhere), `tests/e2e/raffle-fold-and-volunteer-numbers.spec.ts` (at 320 pixels and on a desktop).
changelogLine: - **«Tombolă», a fold of the editor's race numbers** — everything about the raffle in one closed section of «Numere de concurs (BIB)» whose bar says who takes part and how, open again right after the save that changed it, and «Schimbă în editor» on «Ziua cursei» → «Tombolă» lands on it; on the raffle's form, a runner who types «V7» is told that a number starting with V is a volunteer's. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given an event's editor, then «Avem tombolă», «Cine poate participa la tombolă» with «Alergătorii», «Elitele» and «Voluntarii», «Cum participă» and «Înscrierile la tombolă sunt deschise» stand inside one fold «Tombolă» / “Raffle” (`#box-raffle`, a level-4 fold of «Numere de concurs (BIB)»), closed on arrival, posting the same names and markers to the same save; its closed line says «nu avem» / “none” without a raffle, else the groups ticked and how — «Alergători, elite, voluntari · din oficiu» / “Runners, elites, volunteers · automatically”; it opens by itself, with «Numere de concurs (BIB)» and «Participare, înscrieri și regulament», on the page a save that moved one of the raffle's settings returns to (`?saved=event&raffle=1`, the save's own answer) — never after a save that moved none — and around a box a refusal names; and «Schimbă în editor» on «Ziua cursei» → «Tombolă» leads to it (`#box-raffle`), open with the cards around it on arrival (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an event whose raffle counts the volunteers, then neither the editor's «Tombolă» nor «Ziua cursei» → «Tombolă» draws anything about setting the volunteers' numbers — no line, no link to a numbers form, no such words left in either catalogue —: the confirmed volunteers take part with the V numbers they drew at «Confirmă», counted beside «Voluntari: N» and written V001, V002 after the race numbers; a volunteer is out only while not confirmed, when taken out by the organizers or, «Cu înscriere separată», until signed up, as the person's row says; and reading either page gives nobody a number (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the raffle's public form of an event whose volunteers may take part, when a number starting with V — «V7» — is posted with «Sunt voluntar» unticked, then it is refused as the box to fix, what was typed kept in the box, and the words under it say «Un număr care începe cu V e al unui voluntar: bifează „Sunt voluntar” mai jos. Numărul de concurs al unui alergător are doar cifre.» / “A number starting with V is a volunteer's: tick “I'm a volunteer” below. A runner's race number is digits only.”; a runner's other malformed number, a volunteer's malformed number with the box ticked, and any number on an event whose volunteers may not take part keep «Scrie numărul de concurs, doar cifre.» / “Type the race number, digits only.” (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: «Tombolă» folded in the editor, and a runner's «V7» told whose number it is
